description: Parse DMARC aggregate (RUA) reports and SMTP TLS reports (TLS-RPT, RFC 8460) into an actionable summary. Accepts the raw XML / JSON or the email attachment as base64 (.xml, .xml.gz, .zip). DMARC: reporter, date range, published policy, message totals, DMARC / DKIM-aligned / SPF-aligned pass rates, dispositions, every sending source IP with its auth results and a verdict (authorized, forwarded / third-party, spoofing), top failing sources and concrete next steps (e.g. when it is safe to move from p=none to quarantine). TLS-RPT: per-policy success / failure counts and failure details. No DNS or network lookups. Price: $0.003 USDC per successful call (x402, Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/dmarc-report-parse

report.description: Report XML / JSON, or base64 of the .xml / .gz / .zip attachment
